terms.comment: Our description: an animal stuffed with stuffing, as Traupman’s sofa is torus tōmentō fartus (pp. 123, 125). Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for a stuffed animal or a soft toy; for a toy bear see teddy bear.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 123, 125.
